name: raw-investor
description: Raw Investor - Microsoft Windows Pokemon card ROI and market analytics app built with Vite, React, TypeScript, Edge/Chrome capture, PriceCharting, TCGplayer, eBay comps, and grading EV signals.
author: RawGraded

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --kill-signal SIGTERM -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:icon && node scripts/sync-brand-assets.mjs && node scripts/sync-streamer-skins.mjs && npm --prefix client run build:runtime
scripts.build:all: npm run build:icon && node scripts/sync-brand-assets.mjs && node scripts/sync-streamer-skins.mjs && npm run clean:dist-assets && npm --prefix client run build && npm run prepare:api-dist && npm run rebuild:server-native && npm run prepare:server-prod-modules && npm run prepare:playwright-browsers && npm run prepare:encrypted-runtime && node scripts/clean-electron-production.mjs && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false CSC_LINK= CSC_KEY_PASSWORD= CSC_NAME= WIN_CSC_LINK= WIN_CSC_KEY_PASSWORD= electron-builder --config rawengine-builder.yml --win dir nsis portable && node scripts/verify-installer-artifacts.mjs && node scripts/package-extension-zip.mjs && node scripts/smoke-packaged-unpacked.mjs && node scripts/zip-encrypted-release.mjs
scripts.prepare:api-dist: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.prepare:beta-dist: npm run build:icon && node scripts/sync-brand-assets.mjs && node scripts/sync-streamer-skins.mjs && npm run prepare:renderer-dist && npm run prepare:api-dist && npm run rebuild:server-native && npm run prepare:server-prod-modules && npm run prepare:playwright-browsers && npm run prepare:encrypted-runtime
scripts.prepare:tester-dist: npm run clean:dist-assets && npm run prepare:beta-dist
scripts.build:tester: npm run prepare:tester-dist && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false CSC_LINK= CSC_KEY_PASSWORD= CSC_NAME= WIN_CSC_LINK= WIN_CSC_KEY_PASSWORD= electron-builder --config rawengine-builder.tester.yml --win dir nsis portable && node scripts/zip-electron-tester-unpacked.mjs
scripts.beta:dev: concurrently --kill-others --kill-signal SIGTERM -n server,client,rawengine -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env RAWENGINE_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 RAWENGINE_API_URL=http://localhost:3001 electron ./rawengine/main.cjs"
scripts.beta:build: npm run prepare:beta-dist && node scripts/clean-electron-production.mjs && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false CSC_LINK= CSC_KEY_PASSWORD= CSC_NAME= WIN_CSC_LINK= WIN_CSC_KEY_PASSWORD= electron-builder --config rawengine-builder.yml --win dir nsis portable && node scripts/verify-installer-artifacts.mjs
scripts.beta:build:commercial: npm run prepare:beta-dist && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false CSC_LINK= CSC_KEY_PASSWORD= CSC_NAME= WIN_CSC_LINK= WIN_CSC_KEY_PASSWORD= electron-builder --config rawengine-builder.commercial-beta.yml --win nsis && node scripts/verify-installer-artifacts.mjs
scripts.beta:build:commercial:checked: npm run beta:build:commercial && npm run release:check-secrets
scripts.beta:build:checked: npm run beta:build && npm run release:check-secrets
scripts.beta:build:signed: node scripts/ensure-win-codesign-cache.mjs && npm run prepare:beta-dist && electron-builder --config rawengine-builder.signed.yml --win dir nsis portable
scripts.beta:build:signed:checked: npm run beta:build:signed && npm run release:check-secrets
scripts.release:build: npm run beta:build:signed:checked && npm run release:verify-win-signatures
scripts.release:build:all: npm run build:icon && node scripts/sync-brand-assets.mjs && node scripts/sync-streamer-skins.mjs && npm run clean:dist-assets && npm --prefix client run build && npm run prepare:api-dist && npm run rebuild:server-native && npm run prepare:server-prod-modules && npm run prepare:playwright-browsers && npm run prepare:encrypted-runtime && node scripts/clean-electron-production.mjs && node scripts/ensure-win-codesign-cache.mjs && electron-builder --config rawengine-builder.signed.yml --win dir nsis portable && node scripts/verify-installer-artifacts.mjs && node scripts/smoke-packaged-unpacked.mjs && node scripts/zip-encrypted-release.mjs && npm run release:check-secrets && npm run release:verify-win-signatures
scripts.preview: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client run preview"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test && npm run test:extension
